title: Video Compressor - ShrinkVid
summary: Best video compressor app to reduce video file size. Compress video to any size.
description:
Video too big to share? Low on device storage space? ShrinkVid video compressor can compress video files by up to 90% while keeping video quality intact!

Compress video to your desired file size and easily share it over e-mail, chat, or social platforms.

ShrinkVid Video Compressor Features
- Compress video without losing quality
- Super easy & intuitive video compress app.
- Compress and replace function to free up device storage.
- Supports all video formats (MOV, MP4, FLV, MKV, AVI, 3GP...etc.)
- Quickly share compressed videos.
- Compress video files to any custom size.
- Compress video files to fit Gmail, WhatsApp, Viber, iCloud, Discord, WeChat...etc.
- Compress multiple videos at the same time.
- Respect privacy (compression is done on your device)

Best Quality Video Compress App
- Intelligently compress while preserving video quality.
- Optionally preserve the original video resolution.
- Compare before and after quality.
- Easily compress video files by up to 90% using advanced video codecs.

Compress Video for Email
- Want to send a large video via email? ShrinkVid video compressor can compress videos to fit any email program.
- Compress video to fit WhatApp, iCloud, email
- Easily share on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Viber, Discord, telegram...etc.

Video Resizer
- Easily resize video files to reduce the file size
- Our video resizer can resize video to 4K, 2K, 1080p, 720p, and 360p resolutions
- You can also resize videos to a custom resolution.

Fast Video Compressor
- Video compress in seconds
- The app runs in the background too!

EASILY LOCATE & SHARE COMPRESSED VIDEOS
Easily access all of your compressed videos on the app’s “HISTORY” tab. Plus, once a video is compressed, you can easily share it with friends and family with just a click.

SAVE SPACE & MONEY
Is your phone getting full? Use the ShrinkVid video compressor to shrink and replace videos that take up space. It can also save you a lot of money on cloud storage.

EASILY FIND AND COMPRESS VIDEOS
If your phone is full, most likely it is because a few large videos are taking up space. Our in-app gallery makes it super easy to sort your video library by size, name, date...etc. So you can easily find and compress any video on your phone.

SAVE MOBILE DATA
Are you on a slow or limited mobile data connection but still want to share your beautiful videos with the world? Use the ShrinkVid video compress app to reduce video file size. You will be surprised by the highest video quality at fraction of the original file size! Our video resizer lets you save money on mobile data.

BULK VIDEO COMPRESSOR
Do you have many videos that you wish to compress? You found the right app! ShrinkVid video compressor can easily batch compress videos. You can even apply different video compression settings to each video or apply one setting to all of the videos.
